summary: RecipeSage is a self-hosted recipe management app: a Node/TypeScript monorepo (tRPC router + Express REST routes over a Prisma/PostgreSQL store) where users register, curate their own recipes (create, import, label, meal-plan, share, message), run ML recipe extraction, and browse a community Discover feed.
_build_agent_note: This draft keeps the 125 tools authored in the prior round (probed clean: L0 err=0, login ok, no bad_exec_spec/no_op/wrong_entity/wall_missing). It adds the two Google sign-in flows mined by the refreshed collect (User.signInWithGoogle, User.signInWithDesktopGoogle) as find-or-create auth.register tools. Dropped Auth.desktopGoogleCallback: it is an OAuth code-exchange callback that returns an HTML page and writes no row on any declared entity (the raw guess record.table=User would make ex_emit insert a User with non-column fields and blow its NOT NULL columns); the runtime has no family that can represent it, and its job is already covered by the two sign-in tools.
